title: Redis Cluster bring-up from zero
description: End-to-end: build the oltp-node Packer template, apply the nexus-infra-oltp Terraform env with only Redis enabled, run smoke-0.G.1.ps1, then introspect via `nexus status redis`. Closes Phase 0.G.1.

observe.what: 6 dnsmasq dhcp-host reservations added for redis-1..6 (MACs :70-:75)
Vault PKI role redis-server created + 6 per-node AppRoles + JSON sidecars at $HOME/.nexus/vault-agent-oltp-redis-*.json
6 module.vm clones + firstboot + redis-config + redis-vault-agents + redis-tls + redis-cluster-create overlays applied
~50 checks GREEN: 6 nodes systemd-active · CLUSTER INFO ok+slots=16384 · CLUSTER NODES shows 3 masters + 3 replicas · cross-shard MSET+MGET round-trip · TLS handshake from build host
table of 6 redis nodes with role + status + shard distribution; overall health green

whatProves: Phase 0.G.1 closure: nexus-infra-oltp's oltp-node Packer template builds; the foundation + security + oltp envs cross-coordinate; 6 Redis nodes form a 3+3 cluster with mTLS; the nexus-cli RedisAdapter introspects it correctly.
